# v2.47-dev Release Notes

## Back-navigation now restores your view on every paginated page

v2.46 made the six server-paginated reports remember your filters and page when
you click into a record and press Back. This release extends that to **all** the
remaining paginated pages, so the behaviour is consistent everywhere.

### Fixed

- **The other two paginated reports now remember your view too.** **Currently
  Expired** and **Learner Achievement Scorecard** now keep their filters, search,
  grouping, sort, page number and page size in the page address — so clicking into
  a learner and pressing Back returns you to exactly where you were.
- **The Students and Training lists now remember your page.** These lists already
  remembered your search, column filters and sort on Back; they now also remember
  **which page you were on** (and your chosen page size). So paging deep into the
  Students list, opening someone's record, and pressing Back drops you back on the
  same page instead of at page 1.
- **The "who took this training" list remembers your view.** Opening a training's
  student list, sorting/searching/paging it, clicking into a student and pressing
  Back now restores that list's search, sort and page.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- As with v2.46, these views live in the page address, so they can also be
  bookmarked or shared.
- This completes the back-navigation work: every paginated list in the app now
  restores its view on Back.
